segments.zh: 这是轻读，为 lightnovel.fun 打造的沉浸式阅读脚本。在书籍页面、或列表卡片上的小图标，点一下「沉浸阅读」就能进入干净无干扰的阅读界面，原网页不做任何改动。
segments.en: This is LightNovel Immersive Reader, a userscript for lightnovel dot fun. On any book page — or from the little icon on list cards — one click opens a clean, distraction-free reader. The original page is never modified.

segments.calloutZh: ♾️ 网文无缝连续滚动（v2.0 新增）
segments.calloutEn: Seamless continuous scroll — new in v2.0
segments.zh: 二点零版本新增网文无缝滚动：读到章节末尾继续往下滚，下一章自动接上，章节之间有清晰的分隔带。章节都提前在后台加载好，完全不用等待。
segments.en: New in version two: seamless scrolling. Keep scrolling past a chapter's end and the next chapter flows right in, marked by a clear divider. Chapters are prefetched in the background, so there is never a wait.

segments.calloutZh: 🧭 进度胶囊 + 左侧大纲
segments.zh: 左下角的胶囊实时显示当前章节和全书进度；左侧大纲随阅读自动跟随，点击任意章节即可跳转。
segments.en: The chip at the bottom left tracks your chapter and overall progress. The outline follows along as you read — click any chapter to jump.

segments.calloutZh: 🗺️ Sublime 式缩略图与 ↑/↓ 角标
segments.zh: 右侧是 Sublime 风格的缩略图，精细呈现当前章节窗口；顶部和底部的角标告诉你窗口之外还有多少章，点哪里就跳到哪里。
segments.en: On the right, a Sublime-style minimap shows the loaded chapters in detail. The caps at its edges count the chapters beyond the window — click anywhere to jump.

segments.zh: 切到书签标签，点击任意段落就能添加书签；书签按章节归档，缩略图上也有琥珀色的标记。
segments.en: Switch to the bookmarks tab and click any paragraph to bookmark it — organized per chapter, with amber ticks on the minimap.

segments.zh: 打开设置：纸白、护眼、夜间等主题，可跟随系统明暗，还能自定义底色；字号、行距、页宽、字体都能随心调。
segments.en: Open settings: paper, sepia and night themes, follow-system dark mode, even a custom background color — plus font size, line height, page width and font family.

segments.zh: 界面支持中文和英文，默认跟随系统语言，设置里随时切换。
segments.en: The interface speaks both Chinese and English — it follows your system language and switches anytime.

segments.zh: 续读默认开启：网文回到上次读的章节和章内位置，单篇回到上次的滚动位置。进度按登录账号分开保存，还能导出导入，轻松迁移设备。
segments.en: Resume is on by default: web novels return to your last chapter and position, single articles to the last scroll spot. Progress is saved per account and can be exported to another device.

segments.calloutZh: 🧪 实验性：Calibre 书库 + LLM 元数据
segments.zh: 高级折叠里还有两个实验性功能：把刚读的 EPUB 直接推进 Calibre 书库，以及用大语言模型自动整理书籍元数据。
segments.en: Under the advanced fold, two experimental extras: push the EPUB you just read straight into a Calibre library, and tidy book metadata with a large language model.

segments.calloutEn: Classic paged mode, one toggle away
segments.zh: 更喜欢一章一页？关掉「网文连续滚动」，就回到传统的上一章、下一章翻页模式——随时可以再打开。
segments.en: Prefer one chapter per page? Turn off continuous scroll for the classic previous-and-next pager — and switch back whenever you like.

segments.zh: 忘记某个功能怎么用？设置里的功能向导用聚光灯分步带你重温阅读器的每个角落。
segments.en: Forgot how something works? The feature guide in settings spotlights every corner of the reader, step by step.

segments.zh: 下载整本书：选好章节范围，一键导出带封面和插图的 EPUB，或者纯文本 TXT。
segments.en: Download the whole book: pick a chapter range, then export a full EPUB with cover and images, or plain text.

segments.calloutZh: 📚 换一本「整本贴成一篇」的书
segments.calloutEn: Now: a whole book in a single post
segments.zh: 再来看另一类书：整本内容都贴在同一篇文章里的长文。
segments.en: Now for another kind of upload — an entire book pasted into one single post.

segments.calloutZh: ✂️ 自动分章 + 手动调整
segments.zh: 整本贴成一篇的长文也不怕：阅读器自动识别正文里的目录、切分章节；再点一次「目录」就能手动调整——点击段落分章，点击分隔条合并。
segments.en: Whole books pasted as a single post are no problem: the reader detects the in-text table of contents and splits the chapters automatically. Tap Contents again to adjust by hand — click a paragraph to split, a divider to merge.

segments.calloutZh: ✕ 退出后网站停在你读到的章节
segments.calloutEn: Exit lands where you left off
segments.zh: 退出时，网站会停在你读到的那一章。安装链接见下方说明，祝阅读愉快！
segments.en: On exit, the site lands right on the chapter you were reading. Install link below — happy reading!
